# miniz 3.1.2

Unmodified amalgamated `miniz.c`, `miniz.h`, and `LICENSE` from the official
[3.1.2 release](https://github.com/richgel999/miniz/releases/tag/3.1.2).
Source archive: `miniz-3.1.2.zip`.
SHA-256: `f0446d863f9c19926ad9483c523fdc42e42b8d4a6a431d27e09d49c79a140d9a`.

Compiled into the app for EPUB ZIP reading and CRC validation. Deflate-writing,
archive-writing, and zlib-compatible APIs are disabled through the app Makefile.
No files are extracted onto the reader during validation.
